mxCell.value: ERD cơ sở dữ liệu SQL - User Service và Bilibili Service
users PK id: Integer, index email: String, unique, index, not null hashed_password: String, not null is_active: Boolean, default true created_at: DateTime, default utcnow
roles PK id: Integer, index name: String, unique, index, not null
user_roles PK/FK user_id: Integer -> users.id, cascade PK/FK role_id: Integer -> roles.id, cascade

refresh_tokens PK id: Integer, index token: String, unique, index, not null FK user_id: Integer -> users.id, cascade, not null expires_at: DateTime, not null created_at: DateTime, default utcnow is_revoked: Boolean, default false

social_profiles PK id: Integer, index FK user_id: Integer -> users.id, cascade, not null platform: String, not null profile_name: String, not null username: String, nullable folder_path: String, unique, not null status: String, default active created_at: DateTime, default utcnow

social_profile_strategies PK id: Integer, index FK user_id: Integer -> users.id, cascade, index, not null FK profile_id: Integer -> social_profiles.id, cascade, unique, index, not null content_topics: Text, default empty avoid_topics: Text, default empty tone: String, default ngắn gọn... target_audience: String, default empty post_frequency_per_day: Integer, default 2 active_hours: String, default 08:00-11:00,19:00-22:00 schedule_enabled: Boolean, default true schedule_days: String, default 0,1,2,3,4,5,6 schedule_times: String, default 08:30,20:30 schedule_timezone: String, default Asia/Bangkok approval_mode: String, default manual risk_level: String, default medium min_score: Float, default 70.0 require_video: Boolean, default false auto_queue_enabled: Boolean, default true auto_publish_enabled: Boolean, default false created_at: DateTime, default utcnow updated_at: DateTime, default utcnow/onupdate

article_profile_matches PK id: Integer, index FK user_id: Integer -> users.id, cascade, index, not null FK profile_id: Integer -> social_profiles.id, cascade, index, not null article_link: String, index, not null article_title: String, not null score: Float, default 0.0 decision: String, default skip reason: Text, nullable suggested_platform: String, nullable matched_topics: Text, default empty created_at: DateTime, default utcnow

publishing_queue_items PK id: Integer, index FK user_id: Integer -> users.id, cascade, index, not null FK profile_id: Integer -> social_profiles.id, cascade, index, not null FK match_id: Integer -> article_profile_matches.id, set null article_link: String, index, not null article_title: String, not null platform: String, not null generated_content: Text, nullable ai_reason: Text, nullable status: String, default queued, index scheduled_at: DateTime, nullable, index published_at: DateTime, nullable error: Text, nullable created_at: DateTime, default utcnow updated_at: DateTime, default utcnow/onupdate

social_posts PK id: Integer, index FK profile_id: Integer -> social_profiles.id, cascade, index, not null title: String, not null post_url: String, nullable platform_post_id: String, nullable caption: Text, nullable status: String, default published published_at: DateTime, default utcnow created_at: DateTime, default utcnow

social_post_metrics PK id: Integer, index FK post_id: Integer -> social_posts.id, cascade, index, not null views: Integer, default 0 likes: Integer, default 0 comments: Integer, default 0 shares: Integer, default 0 captured_at: DateTime, default utcnow, index

bilibili_jobs PK id: Integer, index user_id: Integer, nullable, index status: String, index, not null stage: String, index, not null progress: Integer, default 0, not null input_text: Text, not null niche: String, not null max_duration_seconds: Integer, default 180, not null source_url: Text, nullable source_platform: String, nullable source_title: Text, nullable artifacts_json: Text, default {}, not null error_message: Text, nullable created_at: DateTime, default utc_now, not null updated_at: DateTime, default/onupdate utc_now, not null
users 1 - n refresh_tokens
users 1 - n social_profiles
social_profiles 1 - 0..1 strategies
social_profiles 1 - n matches
social_profiles 1 - n queue
matches 0..1 - n queue
social_profiles 1 - n posts
social_posts 1 - n metrics
Ghi chú: bilibili_jobs.user_id hiện không khai báo ForeignKey trong code, nhưng về nghiệp vụ tham chiếu người dùng hiện tại.
